process.title: 实现 windscale.py 蒲福风级与 tests/test_windscale.py
process.scope: Owns only windscale.py and tests/test_windscale.py. Does not touch dijkstra, nthprime, any existing file, or any team/** path. Stdlib only; must not import the other two modules.
process.task:
Create windscale.py (new file only, do not modify any existing file) implementing the work order's Beaufort scale spec, plus tests/test_windscale.py covering every acceptance item.

Spec (verbatim requirements):
- Thresholds pinned (unit km/h, lower bound inclusive, upper bound is the next level's lower bound): level 0 <1; 1: 1–5; 2: 6–11; 3: 12–19; 4: 20–28; 5: 29–38; 6: 39–49; 7: 50–61; 8: 62–74; 9: 75–88; 10: 89–102; 11: 103–117; 12: >=118.
- beaufort(speed_kmh) -> int: speed must be int/float (bool rejected); non-numeric raises TypeError; negative raises ValueError; returns level 0–12.
- beaufort_label(speed_kmh) -> str: returns the Chinese name; levels 0–12 in order are 无风、软风、轻风、微风、和风、清风、强风、疾风、大风、烈风、狂风、暴风、飓风; input validation same as beaufort.

Acceptance items (each needs a corresponding test case, transcribed exactly):
- beaufort(0) == 0; beaufort(0.9) == 0; beaufort(1) == 1; beaufort(5) == 1; beaufort(6) == 2; beaufort(11) == 2; beaufort(12) == 3; beaufort(19) == 3; beaufort(20) == 4; beaufort(28) == 4; beaufort(29) == 5; beaufort(38) == 5; beaufort(39) == 6; beaufort(49) == 6; beaufort(50) == 7; beaufort(61) == 7; beaufort(62) == 8; beaufort(74) == 8; beaufort(75) == 9; beaufort(88) == 9; beaufort(89) == 10; beaufort(102) == 10; beaufort(103) == 11; beaufort(117) == 11; beaufort(118) == 12; beaufort(200) == 12; beaufort(32.5) == 5.
- beaufort_label(0) == "无风"; beaufort_label(3) == "软风"; beaufort_label(30) == "清风"; beaufort_label(55) == "疾风"; beaufort_label(100) == "狂风"; beaufort_label(118) == "飓风".
- beaufort(-1) raises ValueError; beaufort("50"), beaufort(True), beaufort(None) raise TypeError.

Deliverables: only windscale.py and tests/test_windscale.py (both new; never edit existing files). Standard library only.
